name: devflow-ai
description: Multi-agent software development team: backlog selection, confirmed assignment, requirements, implementation, QA, review, and approved Jira updates.

JIRA_SITE_NAME.title: Jira site name (subdomain)
JIRA_SITE_NAME.description: Cloud subdomain only: use 'your-org' for https://your-org.atlassian.net (required for bundled jira-cloud MCP)

JIRA_EMAIL.title: Jira user email
JIRA_EMAIL.description: Email for Jira Cloud API authentication

JIRA_API_TOKEN.title: Jira API token
JIRA_API_TOKEN.description: Atlassian API token (never commit to source control)

JIRA_PROJECT_KEY.title: Default Jira project key
JIRA_PROJECT_KEY.description: Optional default project for backlog queries (e.g. MAG)
